title.narrative: Transformative conservation agriculture in the Ishkashim region

description.narrative: 3 land scarce communities in Ishkashim district turn 30ha of currently fallow land into models for resource conserving pomiculture. Welthungerhilfe is currently installing solar water pumps for irrigation of these land plots. The proposed project complements this measure by adding a component for resource conserving pomiculture, allowing beneficiaries to make maximum use of their precious new water and soil resources.

Climate smart irrigation and pomiculture contribute to the protection of soil and water in Ishkashim border area and improve food security and income opportunities of hundreds of agricultural smallholders.

Total Number of Participants: 931.The beneficiaries of this project are agricultural smallholders of the three target villages Sheikhbek, Zugvand and Yakhshivol. In total 188 dekhan farmers will benefit from this intervention, resulting in over 1000 people (family members) as indirect beneficiaries. For details see table at the beginning of this document.Participating farmers (in Zugvand the entire village - in the other two locations farmers with small current land holdings and the readiness to contribute with free labor) are allocated small plots of 0.1 – 0.4 ha size (depending on location), from which they can retain the harvest. As is common practice in the Ishkashim target area, agricultural work, procurement and sale is coordinated between smallholders.
